description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink project. It contains a class implementation named 'testcase' and various functions related to test case management, including retrieving, updating, copying, and exporting test cases. The file also includes code for testing methods and manipulating test case data.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: A class responsible for managing test cases within the TestLink project, including methods for retrieving, updating, copying, and exporting test case data.

methods.name: get_by_name
methods.description: Retrieve test case information by its name, optionally specifying suite or project names.

methods.name: get_all
methods.description: Retrieve all test cases.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Display test case details on a Smarty template, with various filtering options.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update details of a specific test case.

methods.name: check_link_and_exec_status
methods.description: Check the link and execution status of a test case.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a test case, optionally by version.

methods.name: get_linked_versions
methods.description: Retrieve versions linked to a specific test case.

methods.name: get_testproject
methods.description: Get the project associated with a test case.

methods.name: copy_to
methods.description: Copy a test case to a different location or parent.

methods.name: create_new_version
methods.description: Create a new version of the test case.

methods.name: get_last_version_info
methods.description: Retrieve information about the latest version of a test case.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieve test case data by its ID, version, and status.

methods.name: get_versions_status_quo
methods.description: Get the current status of all versions of a test case.

methods.name: get_exec_status
methods.description: Get execution status for a test case.

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Retrieve keywords associated with a test case.

methods.name: get_keywords_map
methods.description: Retrieve a mapping of keywords for a test case.

methods.name: addKeyword
methods.description: Add a keyword to a test case.

methods.name: addKeywords
methods.description: Add multiple keywords to a test case.

methods.name: copyKeywordsTo
methods.description: Copy keywords from one test case to another.

methods.name: deleteKeywords
methods.description: Delete keywords from a test case.

methods.name: get_executions
methods.description: Retrieve execution records for a test case.

methods.name: get_last_execution
methods.description: Get the last execution record of a test case.

methods.name: get_version_exec_assignment
methods.description: Get assignment details for a test case version.

methods.name: update_active_status
methods.description: Update the active status of a test case version.

methods.name: copy_attachments
methods.description: Copy attachments from one test case to another.

methods.name: deleteAttachments
methods.description: Remove all attachments linked to a test case.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_design
methods.description: Get custom fields linked at the design level for a test case.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_inputs
methods.description: Generate an HTML table of custom field input elements for a test case.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_values
methods.description: Generate an HTML table of custom field values for a test case.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_execution
methods.description: Get custom fields linked at the execution level for a test case.

methods.name: copy_cfields_design_values
methods.description: Copy custom field values from design to execution for a test case.
